item.title: Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 97 platoons across seven districts, with five more on standby, amid ongoing political violence and labour unrest. / In Bangladesh, banned Awami League members loot and burn properties in Gopalganj District, including BNP MP Md.
item.description:
Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 97 platoons across seven districts, with five more on standby, amid ongoing political violence and labour unrest.

Sources: The Guardian, The Daily Star

In Bangladesh, banned Awami League members loot and burn properties in Gopalganj District, including BNP MP Md. Selimuzzaman Mollah's ancestral home, a police station, and a Grameen Bank branch, and vandalise BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami properties. Separately, attackers burn the homes of former politicians Rahim Ullah in Feni District, Shahriar Alam in Rajshahi District and Mahmud Hasan Sumon in Mymensingh District.

Sources: BSS, The Financial Express

item.title: In Gopalganj District, armed members of the banned Awami League, Chhatra League, and Jubo League detonate crude bombs and set fire to a private clinic owned by BNP Member of Parliament K M Babar of… / A crowd led by Chatra Dal members storms and sets fire to the residence of former Awami League Member of Parliament Shamim Osman in Narayanganj District, while unidentified attackers loot and set… / Two Bangladesh Nationalist Party members are killed when suspected members of the banned Awami League attack a motorcycle procession in Narail District, Bangladesh.
item.description:
In Gopalganj District, armed members of the banned Awami League, Chhatra League, and Jubo League detonate crude bombs and set fire to a private clinic owned by BNP Member of Parliament K M Babar of Gopalganj-2, forcing patients to evacuate. Attackers also burn at least five BNP offices across Muksudpur and Kashiani and target two Grameen Bank branches.

Sources: Dhaka Tribune

A crowd led by Chatra Dal members storms and sets fire to the residence of former Awami League Member of Parliament Shamim Osman in Narayanganj District, while unidentified attackers loot and set fire to two houses belonging to former Minister of Fisheries and Livestock SM Rezaul Karim in Pirojpur District. Separately, arsonists burn the residence of former Minister of Foreign Affairs Dipu Moni in Chandpur, and a crowd in Sirajganj vandalises the local Awami League office and the residence of former MP Habibe Millat.

Sources: Views Bangladesh, The Daily Star, The Daily Star

Two Bangladesh Nationalist Party members are killed when suspected members of the banned Awami League attack a motorcycle procession in Narail District, Bangladesh.

Sources: Daily Sun

item.title: The Pan American Health Organization revokes the measles elimination statuses of Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States.
item.description:
The Pan American Health Organization revokes the measles elimination statuses of Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States. For the U.S., the organization cited continuous domestic transmission for over 12 months amid more than 5,700 reported infections and multiple deaths in 2026.

item.description:
France and Malaysia establish a strategic partnership, signing agreements on defence, energy, and technology cooperation during French president Emmanuel Macron's state visit. Malaysia also agrees to permit limited exports of unprocessed rare-earth minerals to France in exchange for assistance with mineral processing.

item.description:
The North Macedonian Agency for National Security arrests five Macedonian nationals allegedly linked to an assassination plot in Greece, allegedly involving Iranian recruiters, including Naji Sharifi-Zindashti, who is wanted by the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation. A sixth person remains at large. Greek public television reports that the target was a Israeli business executive based in Athens.
